claims: Coachella Weekend 2 is scheduled for April 17–19, 2026.
Coachella Weekend 2 is at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, CA.
Sabrina Carpenter is the Friday headliner for Coachella Weekend 2.
Justin Bieber is the Saturday headliner for Coachella Weekend 2.
Karol G is the Sunday headliner for Coachella Weekend 2.
Other scheduled performers for Coachella Weekend 2 include The Strokes, Foster the People, Labrinth, Disclosure, Young Thug.
Notable acts for Coachella Weekend 2 include The xx, Major Lazer, Laufey, Iggy Pop, Interpol, PinkPantheress, Little Simz, Turnstile, Devo, and Blood Orange.
